name: Hotel Angerhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Angerhof is located in Brixental in Tirol and offers a quiet location with views of the surrounding mountain landscape. The rooms are furnished with traditional wooden furniture and have a bathroom, TV, and some have a balcony. The half-board arrangement includes a breakfast buffet and dinner with a choice of menu. The sauna area in the house is available to guests daily. Hiking trails and cross-country ski trails start directly behind the hotel, which makes the stay attractive for active holidaymakers. A ski bus stops near the hotel and takes guests to the surrounding ski areas. The hotel has ample parking and a storage room for bicycles and ski equipment.
